Definition: neuter of the comparative of G1451; nearer:--nearer.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says our salvation is nearer than when we believed in Romans 13:11 — time has passed, the night is far spent, and it is high time to wake out of sleep.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every day brings my salvation one day nearer, and that should wake me up, not put me to sleep.
